text:
elaine: Quick heads-up from today's console walkthrough — the docs flyout has at least three issues: inconsistent CTA copy, deep-link anchors being lost, and link previews showing the support site not the dev docs.

sam: Got screenshots? I noticed the CTA said "Open docs" in one place and "Read article" in another.

elaine: Uploaded two snaps to the thread. Also observed that promo query params like `?utm_source=console` get stripped when redirecting from /help -> /docs. That's causing analytics gaps.

raj: That explains the missing events. Our current rewrite rule does `return 301 /docs$uri;` and nginx is normalizing the querystring. I can change it to `return 301 /docs$request_uri;` but want to confirm there are no edge cases with our CDN cache keys.

maria: Copy perspective: we should standardize on "View in Docs" for in-console CTAs for developer-facing guides. Reserve "Help Center" as an external support hub. Also prefer links that include the article title (e.g., "View in Docs: API keys") for better a11y and link previews.

zoe: Accessibility: descriptive link text is critical. Also ensure the flyout `role=dialog` has `aria-labelledby` pointing to the flyout title. For the CTAs, add `aria-describedby` explaining what opens (same tab vs new tab). If we open a new tab, include `target=_blank rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"` and a visible indicator.

sam: Are we opening docs in a new tab? Current impl opens in same tab for mobile and new tab for desktop via `window.open` heuristic. That feels inconsistent.

elaine: My UX take: keep it consistent -> always open in a new tab for external docs. In-product deep-links that go to other console pages can stay same-tab.

raj: Technically easier to always append `target=_blank` for `/docs` links. CDN cache rules will need a tweak to preserve UTM and anchors; I'll coordinate with infra.

link-bot: Note: link-check job found 12 links in the flyout that 302 -> /docs without anchors. Created task LINK-981.

maria: Also, please avoid using the phrase "Help Center" inside developer docs pages. It confuses devs who expect API content. We should update microcopy in the console nav to say "Docs" and add a small tooltip that points to "Help Center (support)" for users who need product help.

zoe: Contrast nit: the flyout action button uses the brand blue on blue (button on header). At 12px text it's a little low contrast. Can we bold the CTA or bump the tone?

sam: I'll file a tiny UI PR to: 1) normalize CTA copy to "View in Docs" 2) add `rel` attrs and `target=_blank` behavior for docs links 3) add aria labels as Zoe suggested. Putting up tonight.

raj: I'll implement the redirect change to preserve `$request_uri` and add a small integration test that verifies anchors and query params remain intact after redirects. ETA tomorrow morning.

maria: I'll prepare a 1-paragraph canonical copy for the footer and a small style guide snippet for in-product CTAs. Will post to the issue by EOD.

elaine: Two follow-ups: can we also check open graph/meta tags on the docs pages? The preview in Slack previews the support site title right now. That affects link unfurling in messages.

sam: Good catch — docs pages need proper `og:title` and `og:description`. I'll add that to the PR checklist.

zoe: Quick accessibility checklist: focus trap, escape to close, visible focus ring on last interactive element, and ensure screen reader announces "Opening docs, new tab" when we use `target=_blank`.

link-bot: LINK-981 and RED-432 linked in a parent epic: DOCS-UI-121.

elaine: Great. Once the PR + redirect + copy are live, let's run the link-checker and then close out. Thanks everyone.
